en.title: [Akihabara] "VTUBER EXPO 2026" Held During Golden Week at Bellesalle Akihabara
en.summary: "VTUBER EXPO 2026", a large-scale event to experience VTuber culture, will be held at Bellesalle Akihabara from May 3–4, 2026. Features include FUURYUUFES 5.0's four-sided LED booth, an Akihabara-wide campaign linked with JYuno, priority admission tickets, and limited merchandise.
en.content:
## Overview

"VTUBER EXPO 2026" will be held in Akihabara during the Golden Week holiday period. The venue is Bellesalle Akihabara 1F, running for two days from May 3 to 4, 2026.

Marking the 10th anniversary since the birth of VTubers in 2016, this large-scale event is billed as an immersive expo where attendees can experience the current state and future of VTuber culture. It is designed not only for existing fans, but also for first-timers and inbound tourists.

## Highlights

For this event, FUURYUUFES 5.0 has been confirmed as a sponsor, and a special four-sided LED "FUURYUUFES" booth will be set up inside the venue. An immersive experience that feels like stepping into a live festival space where real and virtual converge is planned.

In addition, an Akihabara-wide campaign linked with Emotion Artist "JYuno" will run from April 29 to May 10, 2026. This includes CM broadcasts on the Onoden X Vision and Radi-Kan Vision screens, plus a campaign where customers spending ¥1,000 or more (tax included) at any of 30 Akihabara stores receive one original postcard.

At the main event, a special booth featuring Kizuna AI Inc., a stage event on May 3 hosted by "Baacharu," and venue-limited merchandise are all planned. Merchandise includes acrylic stands and acrylic keychains using newly photographed 3D visuals, heart-shaped badge gashapon, plastic partner cards from the new card game "NEXUS," and EXPO-limited T-shirts.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Bellesalle Akihabara 1F
- **Address**: 3-12-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: May 3–4, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–17:30
- **Admission**: Basically free (priority admission tickets with benefits sold separately)
- **Reservation**: Basic entry is free; time-slot priority admission tickets are sold to manage crowding

## Recommended For

- Those who want to experience the latest VTuber culture all in one place
- Those looking for a large Golden Week event in Akihabara
- Anyone who wants to enjoy LED productions, immersive booths, and merchandise at once
- Those unfamiliar with VTubers who want a gateway introduction

en.title: [Akihabara] Robot Culture Festival "1st Re-ROBO Fess 2026 in Akiba" at Bellesalle Akihabara
en.summary: A robot and drone exhibition and exchange event, "1st Re-ROBO Fess 2026 in Akiba," will be held on May 16, 2026 at Bellesalle Akihabara 1F. General admission is free, with 32 booths from student clubs and companies gathered.
en.content:
## Overview

A robot and drone exhibition and exchange event, "1st Re-ROBO Fess 2026 in Akiba," will be held on May 16, 2026 at Bellesalle Akihabara 1F. Organized by the general incorporated association Akiba Tech Connect, it is presented as Akihabara's largest-scale robot culture festival.

Student clubs, startups, and companies gather under one roof to showcase technologies and ideas related to robots and drones. Admission is free, and the event is structured to be enjoyed by a wide range of visitors in a school culture festival atmosphere.

## Highlights

At the venue, 32 booths from student clubs, startups, and companies will be set up, along with vehicle exhibitions, a play zone, and food trucks. In addition to the latest robot and drone technologies, hands-on content designed for easy visitor participation is also planned.

On the day, an opening ceremony for stakeholders will be held from 9:30 to 11:00, with free admission but prior registration required. General public admission runs from 11:00 to 17:00, with no prior registration required. Exhibitors include ROBOCHIP, Yukai Engineering, and Tokyo Polytechnic University Karakuri Workshop.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Bellesalle Akihabara 1F
- **Address**: 1-14-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: May 16, 2026
- **Hours**: 09:30–17:00 (General public: 11:00–17:00)
- **Admission**: Free
- **Reservation**: Prior registration required for stakeholder opening ceremony only; general public admission requires none

## Recommended For

- Those interested in robot and drone exhibition events
- Those looking for large-scale tech events in Akihabara
- Those who want to see exhibits from student groups and startups all in one place
- Those who want to attend a free, culture-festival-style event with family or friends

A spring test ride event for the electric assist bicycle brand "ERWAY" will be held at Yodobashi Camera Multimedia Akiba in Akihabara. The event runs for two days, April 18–19, 2026, at the JR Akihabara Station Showa-dori Exit area.

title: 無料ジャズイベント「JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS」がワテラスで開催
summary: 無料ジャズイベント「JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS」が、2026年4月24日から26日までワテラス広場などで開催。ブルーノート東京オールスター・ジャズ・オーケストラや民謡クルセイダーズらが出演し、立ち見観覧も可能な3日間イベントとなる。
content:
## 概要

無料ジャズイベント「JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS」が、神田淡路町のワテラスで開催されます。会期は2026年4月24日から4月26日までの3日間で、ワテラス広場の野外特設ステージを中心に、淡路公園、ワテラスモール、Cafe, Dining & Bar 104.5でも展開されます。

JAZZ AUDITORIAは、ジャズを通じて世界の文化に触れる場を目指して2013年に始まった入場無料イベントです。2026年はInternational Jazz Dayとも連携し、ワテラス一帯でライブ、飲食、街歩きを一緒に楽しめる構成になっています。

## 内容

出演は、ブルーノート東京オールスター・ジャズ・オーケストラ directed by エリック・ミヤシロ、ジョン・ビーズリー & 馬場智章によるジョン・コルトレーン生誕100年企画、小野リサ・スペシャル・カルテット、民謡クルセイダーズ、加藤真亜沙トリオ、梅井美咲×須川崇志、明治大学ビッグ・サウンズ・ソサエティ・オーケストラなど。3日間で全8組のプログラムが予定されています。

観覧は基本無料ですが、座席エリアの整理券はLINEによる抽選受付制です。一方で、整理券がなくてもワテラス広場内の立ち見エリアや淡路公園からステージを観覧できます。会場では飲食テントやキッチンカー、親子向け企画「ワテラスキッズ」、学生企画ブースなども案内されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: ワテラス広場 野外特設ステージ、淡路公園、ワテラスモール、Cafe, Dining & Bar 104.5
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区神田淡路町二丁目101番
- **期間**: 2026年4月24日〜4月26日
- **時間**: 各日2〜3公演予定（詳細タイムテーブルは公式サイトで案内）
- **料金**: 入場無料
- **予約**: 座席整理券はLINE抽選制、立ち見観覧は整理券なしでも可能

## こんな人におすすめ

- 秋葉原周辺で無料の音楽イベントを探している方
- ジャズの生演奏を屋外で気軽に楽しみたい方
- 家族や友人と食事や街歩きも合わせて楽しみたい方
- ワテラスや御茶ノ水エリアの大型週末イベントに興味がある方

en.title: [Akihabara] Free Jazz Event "JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS" Held at Waterras
en.summary: The free jazz event "JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS" will be held at Waterras Plaza and surrounding venues from April 24–26, 2026. Performers include the Blue Note Tokyo All-Star Jazz Orchestra and Minyo Crusaders, with standing room available across the three-day event.
en.content:
## Overview

The free jazz event "JAZZ AUDITORIA 2026 in WATERRAS" will be held at Waterras in Kanda Awajimachi. The event runs for three days from April 24 to April 26, 2026, centered on the outdoor special stage at Waterras Plaza, with additional events at Awaji Park, Waterras Mall, and Cafe, Dining & Bar 104.5.

JAZZ AUDITORIA began in 2013 as a free admission event aiming to create a place to experience world culture through jazz. For 2026, it collaborates with International Jazz Day and offers a program where visitors can enjoy live music, food, and a stroll through the Waterras area all at once.

## Highlights

Performers include the Blue Note Tokyo All-Star Jazz Orchestra directed by Eric Miyashiro, a John Coltrane 100th Birthday project by John Beasley & Tomomi Baba, Ono Lisa Special Quartet, Minyo Crusaders, Kato Maasa Trio, Umei Misaki x Sugawa Takashi, and Meiji University Big Sounds Society Orchestra. A total of 8 groups are scheduled across the three days.

General admission is free, but seat area lottery tickets require LINE registration. Even without lottery tickets, visitors can watch the stage from the standing area inside Waterras Plaza or from Awaji Park. The venue also features food tents, food trucks, a family-friendly "Waterras Kids" area, and student activity booths.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Waterras Plaza Outdoor Special Stage, Awaji Park, Waterras Mall, Cafe, Dining & Bar 104.5
- **Address**: 2-101 Kanda Awajimachi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: April 24–26, 2026
- **Hours**: 2–3 performances per day (see official website for detailed schedule)
- **Admission**: Free
- **Reservation**: Seating lottery via LINE; standing viewing without lottery ticket is possible

## Recommended For

- Those looking for free music events around Akihabara
- Those who want to casually enjoy live jazz outdoors
- Those who want to combine dining and a stroll with family or friends
- Those interested in large-scale weekend events in the Waterras/Ochanomizu area

en.summary: A residency results exhibition "Moka Chui BEWARE! New assemblage works using electronic component materials from Akihabara will be unveiled.
en.content:
## Overview

A residency results exhibition "Moka Chui BEWARE! THE FLOWERS BITE!" by Jesse Mineo, during his stay at AIR 3331, will be held. The event runs from April 30 to May 2, 2026, at the 1st floor of AIR 3331 Iwamotocho Residence & Studio.

Jesse Mineo is a New York-born artist who primarily creates assemblage and installation works. This exhibition presents the results created during his residency stay in Iwamotocho, Chiyoda-ku.

## Highlights

The latest assemblage works on display are themed around "memory", drawing inspiration from questions about the nature of memory and nostalgia. The works incorporate materials and parts collected from long-established electronic component stores in Akihabara.

AIR 3331 is a residency program that hosts artists and creators from around the world. This exhibition is a presentation of residency work, and the connection to the streets and materials of the Akihabara area is also one of its highlights.

## Event Details

- **Address**: 3-6-8 Iwamotocho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo

- **Admission**: Free
- **Reservation**: Not required

## Recommended For

- Those interested in contemporary art and installation exhibitions
- Those who want to see works incorporating the materials and memories of the Akihabara area
- Those looking for a small-scale free exhibition to visit during the holiday period
- Those interested in AIR 3331 residency result presentations

title: ルイーダの酒場「ドラゴンクエスト40周年記念イベント」が開催
summary: 秋葉原のルイーダの酒場で「ドラゴンクエスト40周年記念イベント」が、2026年5月12日から8月24日まで開催。40周年記念メニューや注文特典、スタンプラリー特典が登場する。
content:
## 概要

秋葉原のルイーダの酒場で、「ドラゴンクエスト40周年記念イベント」が開催されます。イベント期間は2026年5月12日から8月24日までです。

『ドラゴンクエスト』シリーズは2026年5月27日に発売40周年を迎えます。ルイーダの酒場では、その節目を記念して限定コラボメニューや特典企画を展開し、40周年を祝う場として案内されています。

## 内容

期間中は「ドラゴンクエスト40周年 お祝いスパークリング」「ドラゴンクエスト40周年プレート」「ドラゴンクエスト40周年 スライムトースト」などの記念メニューが提供されます。価格は880G（税込）からで、1G=1円表記です。

さらに、イベントメニュー1点注文ごとにオリジナルコースターを1枚プレゼント。店内で飲食利用した来店者向けにはスタンプラリーも実施され、3ポイントで40周年エンブレム入りのオリジナルアクリルキーホルダーがもらえます。プレスリリース本文には5月27日開始の記載もありますが、開催概要欄では5月12日開始と案内されているため、提供期間は5月12日開始として整理しています。

en.content:

The "Fate/Grand Order" x Gokurakuyu RAKU SPA collaboration campaign "Chaldea SPA Paradise" will be held. The period runs from April 2 to April 27, 2026, with RAKU SPA 1010 Kanda included as a participating store in the Akihabara area.

The Kanda venue, like other participating Gokurakuyu RAKU SPA locations nationwide, will feature a collaboration program using Servants in their post-bath appearance. The content lets visitors enjoy the world of FGO at a spa facility through collaboration baths, interior decorations, collaboration menus, and limited goods.

## Highlights

Upon entry, purchasing the "Chaldea SPA Set" in addition to the admission fee grants a random limited muffler towel. Collaboration goods include acrylic stands, pin badges, locker key-style keychains, clear cards, and clear files. A clear bookmark bonus is also available for every 2,000 yen (tax included) spent on in-store goods.

Each collaboration menu item comes with an original coaster, with drinks starting from 880 yen (tax included). Additionally, 6 types of collaboration baths themed after Charlemagne, Karna, Yamanam Keisuke, Miyamoto Musashi, Sei Shonagon, and Xu Fu will be available, along with in-venue broadcasts and a postcard giveaway program linked to X posts. At the Kanda venue, admission check-in is required for goods purchases, menu orders, and bonus redemptions.

秋葉原駅近くの海鮮・寿司店で実施される期間限定キャンペーンで、通常より手に取りやすい価格で高級寿司の食べ放題を楽しめる内容として案内されています。1日先着5組限定のため、早めの予約が前提になるプランです。

## 内容

プランは90分制の食べ放題で、ラストオーダーは70分。大とろ、中とろ、うに、いくら、金目鯛、えんがわ、真鯛、ぶりなどの握り・軍艦を中心に、サイドメニューも含む50種類が対象です。

予約は食べログからのネット予約限定で、電話予約やキャンセル待ちは不可とされています。また、キャンペーン利用時は1ドリンク注文または飲み放題追加が必須です。仕入れ状況による内容変更の可能性や、食べ残し・シャリだけ残した場合の追加料金にも注意が必要です。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: FUJIYAMA TOKYO 秋葉原本店
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区神田佐久間町1-20
- **期間**: 2026年5月7日〜2026年5月28日の月曜〜木曜
- **時間**: 予約受付は14:00〜23:00、店舗営業時間は平日16:00〜23:00 / 土日15:00〜23:00
- **料金**: 3,900円（税込）
- **予約**: 食べログからの事前予約が必須

## こんな人におすすめ

- 秋葉原で寿司の食べ放題を探している方
- 大とろやうに、いくらを含む高級寿司をお得に楽しみたい方
- 平日の夜に予約して行けるグルメキャンペーンを探している方
- 秋葉原駅近くで会食や友人との食事先を探している方

en.title: [Akihabara] Premium Sushi All-You-Can-Eat Campaign at FUJIYAMA TOKYO Akihabara for 3,900 Yen
en.summary: FUJIYAMA TOKYO Akihabara's "Sankyu All-You-Can-Eat Plan" lets you enjoy premium sushi with 50 varieties for 3,900 yen from May 7 to May 28, 2026. Limited to Monday through Thursday, advance reservation via Tabelog is required.
en.content:
## Overview

FUJIYAMA TOKYO Akihabara will hold a "Sankyu All-You-Can-Eat Plan" offering 50 types of premium sushi for 3,900 yen (tax included). The target period is Monday through Thursday from May 7 to May 28, 2026, excluding national holidays.

This is a limited-time campaign at a seafood and sushi restaurant near Akihabara Station, offering an all-you-can-eat experience with premium sushi at a more accessible price. As the plan is limited to the first 5 groups per day, early reservation is essential.

## Highlights

The plan is a 90-minute all-you-can-eat experience with last orders at 70 minutes. The menu includes approximately 50 varieties centered on nigiri and gunkan such as otoro, chutoro, uni, ikura, kinmedai, engawa, madai, and buri, as well as side dishes.

Reservations are exclusively via Tabelog online; phone reservations and waitlisting are not available. Additionally, one drink order or all-you-can-drink addition is required when using the campaign. Note that menu content may change based on ingredient availability, and additional charges apply for food left uneaten or for rice left on the plate.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: FUJIYAMA TOKYO Akihabara Main Branch
- **Address**: 1-20 Kanda Sakumacho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: Mondays through Thursdays, May 7–28, 2026
- **Hours**: Reservations accepted 14:00–23:00; store hours weekdays 16:00–23:00 / weekends 15:00–23:00
- **Admission**: 3,900 yen (tax included)
- **Reservation**: Advance reservation via Tabelog required

## Recommended For

- Those looking for an all-you-can-eat sushi experience in Akihabara
- Those who want to enjoy premium sushi including otoro, uni, and ikura at a great price
- Those looking for a weekday evening dining campaign with advance reservations
- Those looking for a dining spot near Akihabara Station for a meal with friends

title: グッドスマイルフェス2026東京がベルサール秋葉原で開催
summary: グッドスマイルカンパニーの大型展示イベント「グッドスマイルフェス2026東京」が、2026年6月5日から7日にベルサール秋葉原で開催。一般入場は無料で、6月5日は有料アーリーチケット制となる。
content:
## 概要

グッドスマイルカンパニーによるフィギュアの祭典「グッドスマイルフェス2026東京」が、2026年6月5日から7日まで秋葉原で開催されます。会場はベルサール秋葉原で、1,000点を超える最新フィギュア・プラモデル展示、限定商品の販売、ノベルティ配布などが予定されています。

イベント名はこれまでの「スマイルフェス」から「グッドスマイルフェス」へとアップデートされ、2026年は東京と大阪の2会場で展開されます。秋葉原会場はその先行開催にあたり、フィギュアファンにとって大きな注目イベントになりそうです。

## 内容

東京会場では、2026年6月5日19:00〜21:00に有料アーリーチケット入場を実施し、一般公開より1日早く展示やイベント限定品の販売を楽しめます。アーリーチケットはLivePocketでの抽選販売で、受付期間は2026年4月28日17:00から5月15日23:59まで、価格は500円（税込）です。

一般公開は2026年6月6日10:00〜21:00、6月7日10:00〜18:00で、入場無料です。会場販売では現金、クレジットカード、交通系IC、QRコード決済など幅広い支払い方法に対応予定。販売商品ページでは、会場限定品やオンライン販売対象商品も公開されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: ベルサール秋葉原
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田3-12-8 住友不動産秋葉原ビル
- **期間**: 2026年6月5日〜2026年6月7日
- **時間**: 6月5日 19:00〜21:00（アーリー入場） / 6月6日 10:00〜21:00 / 6月7日 10:00〜18:00
- **料金**: 入場無料（6月5日の有料アーリーチケットは500円）
- **予約**: 一般入場は不要、アーリー入場はLivePocketで抽選販売

## こんな人におすすめ

- 秋葉原で最新フィギュア展示をまとめて見たい方
- グッドスマイルカンパニー作品や限定物販をチェックしたい方
- 無料で入れる大型ホビーイベントを探している方
- 一般公開前に入場できるアーリーチケット情報も押さえたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Good Smile Fest 2026 Tokyo Held at Bellesalle Akihabara
en.summary: Good Smile Company's large-scale exhibition event "Good Smile Fest 2026 Tokyo" will be held at Bellesalle Akihabara from June 5–7, 2026. General admission is free, with a paid early-access ticket system on June 5.
en.content:
## Overview

Good Smile Company's figure festival "Good Smile Fest 2026 Tokyo" will be held in Akihabara from June 5–7, 2026. The venue is Bellesalle Akihabara, with over 1,000 of the latest figures and plastic model displays, limited merchandise sales, and novelty giveaways planned.

The event name has been updated from the previous "Smile Fest" to "Good Smile Fest", and in 2026 it will be held at two venues in Tokyo and Osaka. The Akihabara venue is the earlier of the two, and it is expected to be a major event for figure fans.

## Highlights

At the Tokyo venue, a paid early-access entry will be held on June 5, 2026 from 19:00 to 21:00, allowing attendees to enjoy exhibits and event-exclusive merchandise sales one day before the general public. Early-access tickets are sold via LivePocket lottery, with applications from April 28, 2026 at 17:00 to May 15 at 23:59, priced at 500 yen (tax included).

General public access is free: June 6 from 10:00 to 21:00, and June 7 from 10:00 to 18:00. Venue sales will support a wide range of payment methods including cash, credit cards, transit IC, and QR code payments. Venue-exclusive items and items available for online purchase are also listed on the merchandise page.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Bellesalle Akihabara
- **Address**: Sumitomo Fudosan Akihabara Building, 3-12-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: June 5–7, 2026
- **Hours**: June 5: 19:00–21:00 (early access) / June 6: 10:00–21:00 / June 7: 10:00–18:00
- **Admission**: Free (paid early-access ticket on June 5 is 500 yen)
- **Reservation**: Not required for general admission; early access via LivePocket lottery

## Recommended For

- Those who want to see the latest figure displays all in one place in Akihabara
- Those who want to check out Good Smile Company works and limited merchandise
- Those looking for a large-scale free-entry hobby event
- Those who also want to secure early-access ticket information before general admission

title: すみっコぐらし×あっとほぉーむカフェが神田明神ホールと秋葉原店舗で開催
summary: 「すみっコぐらし」と「あっとほぉーむカフェ」の初コラボが秋葉原で開催。2026年5月6日に神田明神ホールでスペシャルコラボステージ、5月15日から7月31日までAKIBAカルチャーズZONE店Rでコラボカフェを展開する。
content:
## 概要

「すみっコぐらし」と秋葉原のメイドカフェ「あっとほぉーむカフェ」の初コラボ企画が、神田明神ホールと秋葉原店舗で開催されます。

2026年5月6日には神田明神ホールで1日限定のスペシャルコラボステージを実施。続いて2026年5月15日から7月31日まで、あっとほぉーむカフェ AKIBAカルチャーズZONE店Rでコラボカフェが展開されます。

## 内容

神田明神ホールのスペシャルコラボステージは全4公演構成です。Part1は参加無料のキッズステージで、あっとほぉーむカフェのメイドと「しっぽず」によるファミリー向けプログラムを実施します。

Part2はAKIBA BROADWAYと「しっぽず」のコラボステージ、Part3・Part4はメイドと「しろくま」「ぺんぎん？」「とんかつ」「ねこ」「とかげ」が共演するステージです。クイズ、ゲーム、楽曲コラボパフォーマンスなどの参加型企画も案内されています。

コラボカフェでは、描きおろしイラストを使った店内演出、限定メニュー、コラボグッズなどが予定されています。詳細なメニューや提供内容は順次発表予定です。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: 神田明神ホール / あっとほぉーむカフェ AKIBAカルチャーズZONE店R
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田2-16-2 神田明神文化交流館2F / 東京都千代田区外神田1-7-6 AKIBAカルチャーズZONE 5F
- **ステージ日程**: 2026年5月6日
- **カフェ期間**: 2026年5月15日〜7月31日
- **料金**: Part1キッズステージは無料、Part2〜Part4は有料。コラボカフェは店舗利用料金・メニュー代に準ずる
- **予約**: ステージはチケット制。コラボカフェの利用方法は公式案内を確認

## こんな人におすすめ

- すみっコぐらしの限定コラボを秋葉原で楽しみたい方
- 親子で参加しやすいキャラクターイベントを探している方
- メイドカフェ文化とキャラクターコラボの組み合わせに興味がある方
- 限定メニューや描きおろしグッズをチェックしたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Sumikko Gurashi x @home Cafe Collaboration at Kanda Myojin Hall and Akihabara Store
en.summary: The first-ever collaboration between "Sumikko Gurashi" and "@home Cafe" will be held in Akihabara. A special collaboration stage will take place at Kanda Myojin Hall on May 6, 2026, followed by a collaboration cafe at AKIBA Cultures Zone Store R from May 15 to July 31, 2026.
en.content:
## Overview

The first-ever collaboration between "Sumikko Gurashi" and Akihabara maid cafe "@home Cafe" will be held at Kanda Myojin Hall and an Akihabara store.

On May 6, 2026, a one-day-only special collaboration stage will be held at Kanda Myojin Hall. Following this, from May 15 to July 31, 2026, a collaboration cafe will be held at @home Cafe AKIBA Cultures Zone Store R.

## Highlights

The special collaboration stage at Kanda Myojin Hall consists of 4 performances. Part 1 is a free-entry kids stage featuring a family-friendly program with @home Cafe maids and the "Shippozu" characters.

Part 2 is a collaboration stage with AKIBA BROADWAY and "Shippozu". Parts 3 and 4 feature maids performing together with "Shirokuma", "Penguin?", "Tonkatsu", "Neko", and "Tokage". Interactive programs including quizzes, games, and music collaboration performances are also planned.

The collaboration cafe will feature in-store decorations using original illustrations, limited menus, and collaboration goods. Detailed menus and offerings will be announced progressively.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Kanda Myojin Hall / @home Cafe AKIBA Cultures Zone Store R
- **Address**: Kanda Myojin Bunka Koryu-kan 2F, 2-16-2 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo / AKIBA Cultures Zone 5F, 1-7-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Stage Date**: May 6, 2026
- **Cafe Period**: May 15–July 31, 2026
- **Admission**: Part 1 kids stage is free; Parts 2–4 are paid. Collaboration cafe per store admission and menu prices
- **Reservation**: Ticketed for the stage; check official announcements for cafe usage

## Recommended For

- Those who want to enjoy the limited Sumikko Gurashi collaboration in Akihabara
- Those looking for a family-friendly character event
- Those interested in the combination of maid cafe culture and character collaborations
- Those who want to check out limited menus and original merchandise

title: トレカ専門店「TCG GATE」が外神田にグランドオープン
summary: トレーディングカード専門店「TCG GATE」が、2026年4月18日に秋葉原・外神田でグランドオープン。PSA鑑定カードや未開封BOXを中心に扱い、オープン記念の福袋やPSA10オリパも数量限定で販売される。
content:

トレーディングカード専門店「TCG GATE（ティーシージーゲート）」が、2026年4月18日に秋葉原・外神田でグランドオープンしました。場所は外神田4丁目の虎ビル2階で、JR秋葉原駅電気街口から徒歩約5分、東京メトロ銀座線末広町駅から徒歩約1分です。

グランドオープン期間は2026年4月18日から4月20日までの3日間で、数量限定のオープン記念企画が用意されました。PSA鑑定カード、未開封BOX、限定カードなどを封入した福袋に加え、PSA10鑑定カードを含むオリジナルパック全5種を販売する内容です。

販売方法や整理券情報は公式Xで随時案内されるため、来店前に最新情報を確認しておくと安心です。営業時間は12:00〜20:00で、不定休とされています。

- PSA鑑定カードや未開封BOXを探している方

en.title: [Akihabara] Trading Card Specialty Store "TCG GATE" Grand Opens in Sotokanda
en.summary: Trading card specialty store "TCG GATE" grand opened in Sotokanda, Akihabara on April 18, 2026. Centered on PSA-graded cards and unopened boxes, the store also sold limited-edition fukubukuro lucky bags and PSA10 original packs to commemorate the opening.
en.content:
## Overview

Trading card specialty store "TCG GATE" grand opened in Sotokanda, Akihabara on April 18, 2026. The location is on the 2nd floor of Tora Building in Sotokanda 4-chome, approximately 5 minutes on foot from JR Akihabara Station Electric Town Exit and about 1 minute from Tokyo Metro Ginza Line Suehirocho Station.

The store concept is "a base for spreading Japanese trading card culture to the world." It is promoted as an experiential trading card shop focused on collector-oriented products including PSA-graded cards, unopened boxes, and limited cards.

## Highlights

The grand opening period ran for 3 days from April 18–20, 2026, with limited-edition opening commemoration programs. These included lucky bags containing PSA-graded cards, unopened boxes, and limited cards, as well as 5 types of original packs containing PSA10-graded cards.

Sales methods and lottery ticket information are announced via the official X account, so it's advisable to check the latest information before visiting. Store hours are 12:00–20:00, with irregular closures.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: TCG GATE

- **Grand Opening Period**: April 18–20, 2026
- **Hours**: 12:00–20:00 (irregular closures)
- **Admission**: Free entry; merchandise purchased separately
- **Reservation**: Not required; sales methods and lottery info announced via official X

- Those looking for PSA-graded cards and unopened boxes

- Those looking for a card shop near Suehirocho Station

- 秋葉原周辺で子どもの日に立ち寄れる地域イベントを探している方

en.summary: The "2nd Izumibashi Koinobori Festival" will be held on May 5, 2026, along a stretch from Izumibashi Branch Office to Chiyoda Seiga Nursery. Visitors can enjoy koinobori displayed across the street at this local event; the koinobori will remain on display at the Izumibashi Branch Office until May 16.
en.content:
## Overview

The "2nd Izumibashi Koinobori Festival" will be held on May 5, 2026, in the Izumibashi area of Akihabara. Hours are 10:00–17:00, in the stretch between Izumibashi Branch Office and Chiyoda Seiga Nursery.

An announcement has been posted on the Chiyoda-ku bulletin board, stating that koinobori (carp streamers) will be displayed across the road between Izumibashi Branch Office and Chiyoda Seiga Nursery.

## Highlights

This event features koinobori hung along the local street, allowing visitors to enjoy the seasonal scenery in the neighborhood during Children's Day. Organized by the Izumibashi Koinobori Festival Executive Committee. Sponsors listed include the Iwamotocho Kanda Town Association Federation, the Akihabara East Town Association Federation, and the Kanda East Station Town Association.

In case of rain, the event will be changed to a display inside Izumibashi Branch Office. After the event, koinobori will continue to be displayed inside Izumibashi Branch Office from May 6 to May 16, 2026.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Izumibashi Branch Office to Chiyoda Seiga Nursery
- **Address**: 1-11-7 Kanda Sakumacho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo (and surrounding area)
- **Date**: May 5, 2026
- **Hours**: 10:00–17:00
- **Post-event display**: May 6–16, 2026, inside Izumibashi Branch Office
- **Rain alternative**: Display inside Izumibashi Branch Office
- **Admission**: Not listed
- **Reservation**: Not required
- **Inquiries**: 090-3875-7626

## Recommended For

- Those looking for a local Children's Day event to visit around Akihabara
- Those who want to photograph koinobori in a city street setting
- Those who want to check out events in the Izumibashi/Iwamotocho/Kanda area
- Parents and children looking for a short, free-style event to enjoy

title: TVアニメ『クラにか』×アド街っぷPREMIUMタイアップキャンペーン開催

content:

TVアニメ『クラスで2番目に可愛い女の子と友だちになった』と、秋葉原観光マップ「アド街っぷPREMIUM」のタイアップキャンペーンが開催されています。期間は2026年4月10日から5月7日までです。

キャンペーンでは、秋葉原の厳選された10店舗で税込1,100円以上利用した人に、限定ポストカードをプレゼント。あわせて、2026年4月10日発刊の「アド街っぷPREMIUM Vol.155」表紙にもキービジュアルが登場します。

特典は限定ポストカード全10種類で、裏面は共通デザインです。デザインは店舗ごとに異なり、希望する場合は各店スタッフに申し出る形式で案内されています。

対象サービスの提供は各店の営業時間に準じます。特典はいずれの店舗も数量がなくなり次第終了で、期間や内容が予告なく変更される場合があります。対象店舗や詳細は「アド街っぷPREMIUM Vol.155」特集面、またはアド街っぷPREMIUM公式Xで確認できます。

- **会場**: 秋葉原の対象10店舗
- **期間**: 2026年4月10日〜5月7日
- **条件**: 対象店舗で税込1,100円以上利用
- **特典**: 限定ポストカード全10種類（裏面共通、店舗ごとにデザイン違い）
- **料金**: 店舗利用額に準ずる
- **予約**: 不要
- **注意事項**: 特典は数量限定、なくなり次第終了

## こんな人におすすめ

- 『クラにか』の限定ノベルティを集めたい方
- アド街っぷPREMIUMを見ながら秋葉原を巡りたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] TV Anime 'Kuranika' x Admachipp PREMIUM Tie-Up Campaign in Akihabara
en.summary: A tie-up campaign between TV anime 'Kurasu de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onna no Ko to Tomodachi ni Natta' and the Akihabara tourism map "Admachipp PREMIUM" will run from April 10 to May 7, 2026. Spend 1,100 yen or more at any of 10 participating stores in Akihabara to receive a limited postcard.
en.content:
## Overview

A tie-up campaign between TV anime 'Kurasu de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onna no Ko to Tomodachi ni Natta' (Kuranika) and the Akihabara tourism map "Admachipp PREMIUM" is being held. The campaign runs from April 10 to May 7, 2026.

In this campaign, customers who spend 1,100 yen (tax included) or more at any of 10 carefully selected stores in Akihabara will receive a limited postcard. Additionally, the key visual appears on the cover of "Admachipp PREMIUM Vol. 155" published on April 10, 2026.

## Highlights

The bonus is a set of 10 limited postcard designs with a shared back design. Each design varies by store, and customers who want a specific design are asked to notify the store staff.

The bonus service at each store follows the respective store's operating hours. Bonuses at all stores are available while supplies last, and the period and content may change without notice. Participating stores and details can be found in the "Admachipp PREMIUM Vol. 155" feature section or on the official Admachipp PREMIUM X account.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: 10 participating stores in Akihabara
- **Dates**: April 10–May 7, 2026
- **Conditions**: Spend 1,100 yen (tax included) or more at a participating store
- **Bonus**: 10 limited postcard designs (shared back design; different design per store)
- **Admission**: Per store purchase amount
- **Reservation**: Not required
- **Note**: Bonuses are limited in quantity and available while supplies last

## Recommended For

- Those who want to collect limited novelties from 'Kuranika'
- Those who want to explore Akihabara with the Admachipp PREMIUM map
- Those who enjoy walking-style campaigns visiting multiple restaurants and shops
- Those who want to check out Akihabara events tied to the anime broadcast

title: ゲーム開発向け総合イベント「GTMF 2026」東京会場が秋葉原UDXで開催
summary: ゲーム開発向けソリューションの総合イベント「GTMF 2026」の東京会場が、2026年12月8日に秋葉原UDX 4階 UDXギャラリー／UDXギャラリーネクストで開催。展示ブースやセッション、After Partyの実施が予定されている。
content:
## 概要

ゲーム開発向けソリューションの総合イベント「GTMF 2026（Game Tools & Middleware Forum 2026）」の東京会場が、2026年12月8日に秋葉原UDXで開催されます。会場は4階のUDXギャラリーおよびUDXギャラリーネクストです。

GTMFは、ゲーム制作を支えるツール、ミドルウェア、クラウドサービスなどを扱う専門イベントです。2026年は大阪と東京の2会場で開催され、東京会場は秋葉原での実施となります。

## 内容

公式サイトでは、プロダクション現場で活用されているツールやミドルウェア、クラウドサービスを中心に、開発者やベンダーが集まる場として案内されています。

会場では展示ブースやセッションに加え、参加者同士のネットワーキングを目的としたAfter Partyの実施も予定されています。出展・協賛企業は募集中で、昨年は25社が出展・協賛したと紹介されています。参加申し込み、セッション詳細、出展社情報などは今後の発表待ちです。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: 秋葉原UDX 4F UDXギャラリー／UDXギャラリーネクスト
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田4丁目14-1
- **日程**: 2026年12月8日
- **内容**: 展示ブース、セッション、After Party実施予定
- **料金**: 料金記載なし
- **予約**: 参加申し込み情報は未公開

## こんな人におすすめ

- ゲーム開発向けツールやミドルウェアの最新情報を知りたい方
- ゲーム制作、インタラクティブコンテンツ開発に関わる方
- ベンダーや開発者との情報交換、ネットワーキングをしたい方
- 秋葉原で開催される技術系カンファレンスをチェックしている方

en.title: [Akihabara] Game Development Comprehensive Event "GTMF 2026" Tokyo Venue at Akihabara UDX
en.summary: The Tokyo venue for game development solutions event "GTMF 2026" will be held at Akihabara UDX 4F UDX Gallery / UDX Gallery Next on December 8, 2026. Exhibition booths, sessions, and an After Party are planned.
en.content:
## Overview

The Tokyo venue for the game development solutions event "GTMF 2026 (Game Tools & Middleware Forum 2026)" will be held at Akihabara UDX on December 8, 2026. The venue is the UDX Gallery and UDX Gallery Next on the 4th floor.

GTMF is a specialized event covering tools, middleware, cloud services, and other technologies that support game production. In 2026, it will be held at two venues in Osaka and Tokyo, with the Tokyo venue taking place in Akihabara.

## Highlights

The official website describes it as a gathering place for developers and vendors centered on tools, middleware, and cloud services used in production environments.

In addition to exhibition booths and sessions, an After Party for networking among participants is also planned. Exhibitors and sponsors are being recruited; last year, 25 companies exhibited or sponsored. Registration, session details, and exhibitor information will be announced at a later date.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX 4F UDX Gallery / UDX Gallery Next
- **Address**: 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: December 8, 2026
- **Program**: Exhibition booths, sessions, and After Party
- **Admission**: Not listed
- **Reservation**: Registration information not yet announced

## Recommended For

- Those who want to learn about the latest tools and middleware for game development
- Those involved in game production and interactive content development
- Those who want to network and exchange information with vendors and developers
- Those who follow tech conferences held in Akihabara

en.title: [Akihabara] Cafe Veloce Iwamotocho Station Branch to Reopen on May 13
en.summary: Cafe Veloce Iwamotocho Station branch will reopen after renovations on May 13, 2026. The cafe will be closed for refurbishment from April 16 to May 12, and a notice posted at the store announces a free coffee giveaway on May 12 from 11:00 to 13:00.
en.content:
## Overview

"Cafe Veloce Iwamotocho Ekimae" near Exit A3 of Iwamotocho Station will reopen after renovations on May 13, 2026. According to the C-United official store page, the cafe will be closed for refurbishment from April 16 to May 12, 2026, and will reopen on May 13.

Additionally, a notice posted at the store announces a free coffee giveaway on May 12, 2026 (the day before the reopening) from 11:00 to 13:00.

## Highlights

The store is located on the 1st floor of KDX Akihabara Building at 1-14 Kanda Iwamotocho, Chiyoda-ku, a 1-minute walk from Iwamotocho Station Exit A3 and a 3-minute walk from Akihabara Station Showa-dori exit. Regular hours are 7:00–22:00, with free Wi-Fi, seat-side power outlets, various cashless payment options, Uber Eats, a no-smoking policy with a designated smoking booth.

On April 15, 2026 (the day before the renovation closure), hours will be shortened to 19:00. The free coffee giveaway on May 12 is based on in-store notices; please check on-site for the quantity and conditions.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Cafe Veloce Iwamotocho Ekimae
- **Address**: 1F KDX Akihabara Building, 1-14 Kanda Iwamotocho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Renovation Closure**: April 16 – May 12, 2026
- **Free Coffee Giveaway**: May 12, 2026, 11:00–13:00
- **Reopening**: May 13, 2026
- **Regular Hours**: 7:00–22:00
- **Price**: Free coffee giveaway available / regular menu at standard prices
- **Reservation**: Not required

## Recommended For

- Those looking for a work-friendly cafe near Iwamotocho or Akihabara Station
- Those who want to check out the renovated Veloce
- Those who want to stop by for the free coffee giveaway on May 12
- Those checking cafe hours on the Showa-dori side

title: 「学園アイドルマスター×アトレ秋葉原」が5月15日から開催
summary: 「学園アイドルマスター×アトレ秋葉原」が、2026年5月15日から5月28日までアトレ秋葉原1で開催。新規描き下ろし「アーリーサマー」の建物ラッピング、グッズ、特典、コラボフードが展開される。
content:
## 概要

「学園アイドルマスター×アトレ秋葉原」が、2026年5月15日から5月28日までアトレ秋葉原1で開催されます。テーマは「アーリーサマー」。様々な制服姿のアイドルたちが海辺で遊ぶ姿を切り取った新規描き下ろしイラストが公開されています。

会場は東京都千代田区外神田1-17-6のアトレ秋葉原1。建物ラッピング、オリジナルグッズ、オリジナル特典、コラボフードが実施内容として案内されています。

## 内容

期間中は「アーリーサマー」ver.のアイドルたちがアトレ秋葉原の建物を彩ります。オリジナルグッズはアトレ秋葉原1内2階イベントスペース、アイドルマスター オフィシャルショップ拡張スペースで取り扱われます。

特典として、館内各ショップでは500円（税込）ごとに「アトレ秋葉原オリジナルカード」全13種をランダムで1枚配布。イベントスペースでは2,000円（税込）ごとに「アトレ秋葉原オリジナルクリアファイル」A5サイズ全13種をランダムで1枚配布します。いずれもなくなり次第終了です。

コラボフードは、アトレ秋葉原館内の猿田彦珈琲、餃子の王将 Express、エチオピア、寿司 魚がし日本一で販売。5月15日から18日までは店舗ごとに購入方法が異なり、餃子の王将 Express、エチオピア、寿司 魚がし日本一はアトレ公式LINEを使った抽選販売が案内されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: アトレ秋葉原1
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田1-17-6
- **期間**: 2026年5月15日〜5月28日
- **内容**: 建物ラッピング、オリジナルグッズ、オリジナル特典、コラボフード
- **グッズ会場**: アトレ秋葉原1内2Fイベントスペース（アイドルマスター オフィシャルショップ拡張スペース）
- **事前申し込み対象**: 5月15日終日、5月16日オープン〜15:00、5月17日オープン〜15:00
- **コラボフード対象店舗**: 猿田彦珈琲、餃子の王将 Express、エチオピア、寿司 魚がし日本一
- **料金**: 入場無料（物販・飲食は別途）
- **予約**: 一部日時はWEB事前申し込み制

## こんな人におすすめ

- 『学園アイドルマスター』の描き下ろしビジュアルを現地で見たい方
- アトレ秋葉原の建物ラッピングを撮影したい方
- 限定グッズや館内特典をチェックしたい方
- コラボフードもあわせて楽しみたい方

en.summary: "Gakuen Idolmaster x Atre Akihabara" will be held at Atre Akihabara 1 from May 15 to May 28, 2026. The event features new "Early Summer" themed building wraps, merchandise, special bonuses, and collaboration food.
en.content:
## Overview

"Gakuen Idolmaster x Atre Akihabara" will be held at Atre Akihabara 1 from May 15 to May 28, 2026. The theme is "Early Summer," with newly commissioned illustrations showing idols in various uniforms playing by the seaside.

The venue is Atre Akihabara 1 at 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. The event includes building wraps, original merchandise, special bonuses, and collaboration food.

## Highlights

During the event period, the "Early Summer" version of the idols will adorn the Atre Akihabara building. Original merchandise will be sold at the 2nd floor event space inside Atre Akihabara 1 and at the Idolmaster Official Shop expanded space.

As special bonuses, in-building shops will give one random card (1 of 13 types) per ¥500 (tax included) spent, and the event space will give one random A5 clear file (1 of 13 types) per ¥2,000 (tax included) spent — available while supplies last.

Collaboration food will be sold at Saruta Hiko Coffee, Gyoza no Ohsho Express, Ethiopia, and Sushi Uogashi Nihonichi inside Atre Akihabara. From May 15–18, purchasing methods vary by shop; Gyoza no Ohsho Express, Ethiopia, and Sushi Uogashi Nihonichi will use a lottery system via the official Atre LINE account.

- **Venue**: Atre Akihabara 1
- **Address**: 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: May 15–28, 2026
- **Contents**: Building wrap, original merchandise, special bonuses, collaboration food
- **Merchandise Venue**: 2F Event Space inside Atre Akihabara 1 (Idolmaster Official Shop expanded space)

- **Admission**: Free (merchandise and food sold separately)
- **Reservation**: Some dates require advance web registration

## Recommended For

- Those who want to see the new "Gakuen Idolmaster" commissioned visuals in person
- Those who want to photograph the Atre Akihabara building wrap
- Those checking out limited merchandise and in-building bonuses
- Those who also want to enjoy the collaboration food

title: 食品サンプルのながお食研POP UP SHOPがアトレ秋葉原に期間限定オープン
summary: 食品サンプルのながお食研POP UP SHOPが、2026年4月23日から5月6日までアトレ秋葉原1店 1階エスカレーター脇に期間限定オープン。リアルに再現した食品サンプルのかわいいアイテムが並ぶ。
content:
## 概要

食品サンプルの「ながお食研」が、アトレ秋葉原に期間限定POP UP SHOPをオープンしています。期間は2026年4月23日から5月6日まで、場所はアトレ秋葉原1店 1階エスカレーター脇です。

レストランのショーウィンドーで見かける食品サンプルを、かわいいアイテムとして楽しめるショップです。公式告知では、リアルに再現したアイテムが盛りだくさんと案内されています。

content:
## 概要

3人制バスケットボールのグローバルプロリーグ「3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026」の男子ROUND.1開幕戦と女子ROUND.2が、2026年5月16日・17日にワテラスで開催されます。会場は神田淡路町のワテラスで、両日11:00〜18:00の開催です。

男子開幕戦のワテラス開催は2022年から5年連続。男女両方の試合を同じ会場で無料観戦できるイベントとして案内されています。

5月16日・17日は、男子ROUND.1と女子ROUND.2の試合がワテラスで行われます。公式サイトでは、タイムスケジュールと出場チーム情報が日別に案内され、MCは竹本タクシー、DJはDJ YOU MATSUZAKIが担当すると紹介されています。

会場では試合観戦に加え、周辺イベントも実施されます。5月16日13:00〜16:00には、ワテラスキッズ「移動式遊び場」として巨大コリント、ピタゴラ装置、打楽器、積み木などが登場。5月17日11:00〜16:00には東京ヴェルディクラブによるパルクール体験会とキック＆スローターゲット体験会も予定されています。どちらも参加費無料で、スポーツ体験会は雨天中止です。

観戦のお供としてキッチンカーも出店予定です。雨天の場合は会場が変更になる可能性があるため、当日の最新情報は3x3.EXE PREMIER公式サイトで確認してください。

en.title: [Akihabara] 3x3 Basketball "3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026" Men's Opening Round at Waterras
en.summary: The men's ROUND.1 opening game and women's ROUND.2 of the 3x3 basketball pro league "3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026" will be held at Waterras on May 16–17, 2026. All games are free to watch, and the event also features a mobile playground, sports experience sessions, and food trucks.
en.content:
## Overview

The men's ROUND.1 opening game and women's ROUND.2 of the global 3x3 basketball pro league "3x3.EXE PREMIER JAPAN 2026" will be held at Waterras in Kanda Awajicho on May 16–17, 2026. Both days run from 11:00 to 18:00.

This marks the fifth consecutive year the men's opening round is held at Waterras (since 2022). Both men's and women's matches can be watched for free at the same venue.

## Highlights

On May 16 and 17, men's ROUND.1 and women's ROUND.2 matches will take place at Waterras. The official website provides daily schedules and participating team information. MC duties will be handled by Takemoto Taxi, with DJ YOU MATSUZAKI on the decks.

Along with the matches, surrounding events are also planned. On May 16 from 13:00–16:00, the Waterras Kids "Mobile Playground" event will feature a giant Korinto game, Rube Goldberg machines, percussion instruments, and building blocks. On May 17 from 11:00–16:00, Tokyo Verdy Club will host parkour experience sessions and a kick & throw target experience — both free, though the sports experiences will be cancelled in case of rain.

Food trucks will also be on-site to accompany the matches. In the event of rain, venues may change — check the 3x3.EXE PREMIER official website for the latest information on the day.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Waterras
- **Address**: 101, 105 Kanda Awajicho 2-chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: May 16–17, 2026
- **Hours**: 11:00–18:00
- **Contents**: Men's ROUND.1, Women's ROUND.2, mobile playground, sports experience sessions, food trucks
- **Mobile Playground**: May 16, 2026, 13:00–16:00
- **Sports Experience Sessions**: May 17, 2026, 11:00–16:00 (cancelled in rain)
- **Admission**: Free
- **Reservation**: Not required
- **Note**: Venue may change in case of rain

## Recommended For

- Those who want to watch 3x3 basketball live
- Those looking for free sporting events to enjoy
- Those who want to enjoy a children's playground and sports experiences alongside the games
- Those checking out weekend events around Waterras, Ochanomizu, and Akihabara

title: ものづくり館 by YKKでスマホポシェット作りワークショップ開催
summary: ものづくり館 by YKKで、ワークショップ「キラキラファスナーでスマホポシェットを作ろう」が2026年5月2日に開催。オーロライトとメタリックコイルを使い、2.5mのファスナーを縫い合わせてポシェットを作る。
content:
## 概要

ものづくり館 by YKKで、ワークショップ「キラキラファスナーでスマホポシェットを作ろう」が2026年5月2日に開催されます。時間は午前の部10:00〜11:30、午後の部13:00〜14:30です。

会場は秋葉原駅近くのYKK和泉ビル4階。参加費は1,800円（税込）で、各回定員6名の事前予約制です。PassMarketでは予定枚数終了と案内されています。

## 内容

キラキラファスナーを使って、スマートフォンを入れるのにちょうど良いサイズのポシェットを作るワークショップです。使用するファスナーは、エレメントがオーロラのように輝く「オーロライト」と、樹脂製ながら金属の輝きを持つメタリックコイルです。

長さ2.5mのファスナーを縫い合わせて本体を作り、提げヒモもファスナーで仕上げます。エレメントの色はゴールド、シルバー、カッパー、白、水色、パープルの6種類から選択可能。バッグ本体サイズはタテ約22cm×ヨコ約13cm、提げヒモの長さは調節できます。

ミシンを使用するため、参加対象は小学4年生以上です。小学生は保護者同伴で一緒に作製する必要があります。申し込み後は材料準備に入るためキャンセル不可と案内されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: ものづくり館 by YKK
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区神田和泉町1-1 YKK和泉ビル4F
- **日程**: 2026年5月2日
- **時間**: 午前の部 10:00〜11:30、午後の部 13:00〜14:30
- **定員**: 各回6名
- **参加費**: 1,800円（税込）
- **対象**: 小学4年生以上（小学生は保護者同伴）
- **申込方法**: PassMarket予約のみ、事前決済
- **申込締切**: 2026年4月24日 12:00
- **予約**: 必要（予定枚数終了）

## こんな人におすすめ

- ファスナーを使ったものづくりを体験したい方
- 秋葉原で親子参加できるワークショップを探している方
- スマホポシェットや手作り小物に興味がある方
- YKKのファスナー素材を使ったクラフトを楽しみたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Smartphone Pochette-Making Workshop at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK
en.summary: A workshop titled "Let's Make a Smartphone Pochette with Sparkling Zippers!" will be held on May 2, 2026, at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK. Participants will sew 2.5 meters of zipper — using Aurora Light and metallic coil elements — to create a pochette.
en.content:
## Overview

The workshop "Let's Make a Smartphone Pochette with Sparkling Zippers!" will be held on May 2, 2026, at Monodzukuri-kan by YKK. Morning session: 10:00–11:30; Afternoon session: 13:00–14:30.

The venue is the 4th floor of YKK Izumi Building near Akihabara Station. The participation fee is ¥1,800 (tax included), with a limit of 6 participants per session on a reservation-only basis. Registration via PassMarket has been listed as closed.

## Highlights

Participants will use sparkling zippers to make a pochette perfectly sized for a smartphone. The zippers used include "Aurora Light" — with elements that shimmer like aurora — and metallic coil, a resin-based zipper that shines like metal.

Participants will sew together 2.5 meters of zipper to form the body and finish the strap with zipper as well. Element color options include gold, silver, copper, white, light blue, and purple (6 choices). The bag body size is approximately 22cm tall x 13cm wide, with an adjustable strap length.

Since the workshop uses a sewing machine, it is open to 4th grade elementary school students and above. Elementary school students must be accompanied by a guardian who will create together with them. Cancellations are not accepted once materials preparation has begun.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Monodzukuri-kan by YKK
- **Address**: 4F YKK Izumi Building, 1-1 Kanda Izumicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: May 2, 2026
- **Hours**: Morning 10:00–11:30 / Afternoon 13:00–14:30
- **Capacity**: 6 participants per session
- **Fee**: ¥1,800 (tax included)
- **Eligible**: 4th grade elementary school students and above (elementary students must be accompanied by a guardian)
- **Registration**: PassMarket only, advance payment required
- **Registration Deadline**: April 24, 2026, 12:00
- **Reservation**: Required (listed as closed)

## Recommended For

- Those who want to experience crafting with zippers
- Those looking for a parent-child workshop in Akihabara
- Those interested in smartphone pouches and handmade accessories
- Those who want to enjoy crafting with YKK zipper materials

The TV anime "Blue Lock" x Atre Akihabara collaboration event "Unmei no Ichimai" will be held from May 29 to June 11, 2026. The venue is the 2nd floor event space of Atre Akihabara 1.

The theme this time is tarot cards. In addition to new merchandise and sweets using newly commissioned illustrations of Isagi and 7 others, the event features character wraps throughout Atre Akihabara and in-building shop bonuses.

## Highlights

At the event space, items available include acrylic stands, trading can badges, pair acrylic plates, tarot cards, acrylic keychains, and Anisugar fruit donuts. Purchase limits apply: trading items up to 2 BOX or 20 pieces each; other new items and Anisugar sweets up to 3 pieces each.

As in-building bonuses, for every ¥500 (tax included) spent at participating shops in Atre Akihabara 1 and 2 during the event period, you will receive one random character card (1 of 16 types). At the event space, every ¥3,000 (tax included) or more spent entitles you to one entry in a guaranteed lottery. Prizes include postcards, postcard sets, and a life-size standee panel.

Due to anticipated crowds, entry on May 29, 30, and 31 from opening until 14:00 will be by advance lottery. The application period runs from April 24, 18:00 to May 6, 23:59, 2026, with results announced on May 8 at 18:00.

en.content:
## Overview

The "Gintama Chara Pop Store" is being held at Bandai Namco Cross Store Atre Akihabara. The event runs from April 17 to November 23, 2026, at Chara Pop Store Branch 2 on the 2nd floor of Atre Akihabara 1.

The concept for this event is "Shippuu Doto" (Storm and Fury). Newly commissioned illustrations of Gintoki Sakata, Toshiro Hijikata, Sougo Okita, Kotaro Katsura, Shinsuke Takasugi, and Kamui will be rolled out in character-specific campaigns.

## Highlights

At the venue, original goods using newly commissioned and mini-character illustrations are available, including acrylic stands, tapestries, can badge sets, acrylic objects, and tag keychains.

A mini-game called "Gintama Garapon" also lets you win original prizes. Each play costs ¥660 (tax included), with prizes such as acrylic boards, square can badges, and die-cut stickers.

The schedule for each character campaign is as follows: Hijikata Festival through May 11; Kamui Festival from May 12 to June 5; Katsura Festival from June 6 to June 29; Okita Festival from June 30 to July 29; Takasugi Festival from July 30 to September 2; Gintoki Festival from September 3 to October 12; and a Grand Finale from October 13 to November 23.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Bandai Namco Cross Store Atre Akihabara
- **Address**: Chara Pop Store Branch 2, 2F Atre Akihabara 1, 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: April 17 – November 23, 2026
- **Hours**: 10:00–21:00
- **Contents**: Original merchandise, mini-game, purchase bonuses
- **Admission**: Free (merchandise and mini-games sold separately; Garapon ¥660/play)

## Recommended For

- Those who want to collect newly commissioned "Gintama" merchandise
- Those who enjoy Chara Pop Store exclusive mini-games
- Those looking for a long-running character event at Atre Akihabara
- Those who want to follow each character's dedicated campaign

title: 「ファーストキャビン秋葉原」が6月1日に再オープン
summary: 休業していたコンパクトホテル「ファーストキャビン秋葉原」が、2026年6月1日に再オープン。5月1日から公式サイトで予約受付を開始し、14連泊プランも販売する。
content:
## 概要

休業していたコンパクトホテル「ファーストキャビン秋葉原」が、2026年6月1日に再オープンします。

施設名は「ファーストキャビン秋葉原昭和通り」から「ファーストキャビン秋葉原」へ改められ、2026年5月1日から公式サイトで予約受付が始まっています。

## 内容

ファーストキャビン秋葉原は、2021年から休業していた秋葉原エリアのコンパクトホテルです。再オープンにあたり、館内設備の一部リニューアル、清掃・メンテナンス、サービスの見直しを行ったと案内されています。

設備面では、ロビーラウンジ、パウダールーム、シャワーブース、大浴場などを備え、男女別フロアも用意。コインランドリーは従来の2台から5台へ増設され、長期滞在やビジネス利用にも対応します。

開業記念として、公式サイト会員登録限定の14連泊プランも販売。秋葉原を拠点にした仕事、観光、推し活向けの滞在先として使える施設になりそうです。

en.title: [Akihabara] First Cabin Akihabara Reopens on June 1
en.summary: The compact hotel "First Cabin Akihabara", which had been closed, will reopen on June 1, 2026. Reservations open on the official website from May 1, with a 14-night stay plan also available.
en.content:
## Overview

The compact hotel "First Cabin Akihabara", which had been closed, will reopen on June 1, 2026.

The facility has been renamed from "First Cabin Akihabara Showa-dori" to "First Cabin Akihabara," with reservations opening on the official website from May 1, 2026.

## Highlights

First Cabin Akihabara is a compact hotel in the Akihabara area that had been closed since 2021. The reopening includes partial renovation of facilities, cleaning and maintenance, and a review of services.

The property offers a lobby lounge, powder room, shower booths, and a large communal bath, with separate male and female floors. The coin laundry has been expanded from 2 to 5 units, making it well-suited for extended stays and business travel.

As an opening celebration, a 14-night stay plan exclusive to official website members is also available. The hotel positions itself as a convenient base for work, sightseeing, or fan activities centered around Akihabara.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: First Cabin Akihabara
- **Address**: 38 Kanda Sakumacho 3-chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Opening date**: June 1, 2026
- **Capacity**: 149 cabins
- **Facilities**: Lobby lounge, powder room, shower booths, communal bath, and more
- **Price**: Check official website or booking sites
- **Reservation**: Accepting reservations on the official website

## Recommended For

- Those looking for accommodation near Akihabara Station
- Fans wanting a home base for events and activities
- Those looking for a compact hotel suitable for extended stays

4階UDXギャラリーでは、VRデバイスやクリエイター支援サービスなどの企業展示を実施。VRChat Inc.の出展、VRChat運営と交流できるコーナー、VRChat Inc.などによるステージイベントも予定されています。ラウンジエリアを利用できる有料チケット『超メタフェスPlus』や、夜の懇親会も用意されます。

en.title: [Akihabara] VR Community Event "Chometa Fes 2026" at Akihabara UDX
en.summary: "Chometa Fes 2026", an event bringing together VR users, VR creators, and VR-related companies, will be held at Akihabara UDX on May 23, 2026. It features a creator market, company exhibits, an official VRChat booth, stage events, and an evening meetup.
en.content:
## Overview

"Chometa Fes 2026", a community event for VR users, VR creators, and VR-related companies, will be held at Akihabara UDX on May 23, 2026. The venues are Akiba Square on the 2nd floor, UDX Gallery on the 4th floor, and UDX Gallery Next on the 4th floor.

The daytime program is free for general attendees and includes a creator market by VRChat creators, VR-related company exhibits and demos, and stage events. An evening meetup requiring advance registration is also planned.

## Highlights

At Akiba Square on the 2nd floor, a creator market featuring VRChat creators will be held. The area has expanded to about 130 spaces, and visitors leaving the 2nd-floor market will receive VRChat avatar stickers and a JINGO illustrated clear file while supplies last.

On the 4th floor at UDX Gallery, companies will exhibit VR devices and creator support services. VRChat Inc. will also exhibit, with a corner where visitors can meet VRChat staff and stage events by VRChat Inc. and others. Paid "Chometa Fes Plus" tickets for lounge access and an evening meetup are also available.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX 2F Akiba Square / 4F UDX Gallery / 4F UDX Gallery Next
- **Address**: 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: May 23, 2026
- **Hours**: Daytime 11:00–16:00 (company exhibit and exchange areas until 17:00) / Evening 17:30–20:30
- **Admission**: Daytime free (lounge area paid only); evening meetup ¥5,500 (tax included)
- **Reservation**: Advance registration is required for general attendees. A VRChat ID is required to apply

## Recommended For

- Those who want to join an in-person VRChat or metaverse culture event
- Those interested in a VR creator market
- Those who want to try the latest VR devices and tracking equipment
- Those looking for a large community event at Akihabara UDX

en.summary: "Analog Audio Fair 2026", an exhibition and sales event for analog audio equipment and record-related products, will be held at Sonpo Kaikan in Akihabara on May 30 and 31, 2026. Admission is ¥500 and valid for both days; students and visitors age 30 or younger can enter free with proof.
en.content:
## Overview

"Analog Audio Fair 2026", an exhibition and sales event for analog audio equipment, accessories, and record-related products, will be held at Sonpo Kaikan in Akihabara on May 30 and 31, 2026.

The venue is Sonpo Kaikan at 2-9 Kanda Awajicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. It is about a five-minute walk from JR Akihabara Station's Electric Town Exit and JR Ochanomizu Station's Hijiribashi Exit.

## Highlights

The official site introduces the fair as an event created to help people continue enjoying high-quality analog record playback and to introduce analog audio to a wider audience. It is aimed at visitors interested in analog players, cartridges, related accessories, records, and similar products.

Admission is ¥500 (tax included) and valid for both days. Students can enter free by showing a student ID, and visitors age 30 or younger can enter free by showing proof of age. PHILE WEB also describes the event as an opportunity to see analog playback brands and enjoy listening comparisons.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Sonpo Kaikan, Akihabara
- **Address**: 2-9 Kanda Awajicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: May 30–31, 2026
- **Hours**: May 30, 12:00–19:00 / May 31, 10:00–18:00
- **Admission**: ¥500 (tax included, valid for both days); free for students and visitors age 30 or younger with proof
- **Reservation**: No advance reservation is listed on the official site

## Recommended For

- Fans of analog records and audio equipment
- Those who want to compare players, cartridges, and accessories
- Those looking for a weekend exhibition around Akihabara and Ochanomizu
- Students and visitors age 30 or younger who can attend free and experience audio gear

en.content:

GODIVA Atre Akihabara is featuring chilled desserts that let customers enjoy cacao as a fruit. The Atre Akihabara shop news introduces fruit jellies, Mousse Chocolat et Cacao Fruit Gelee, and summer gift assortments made with cacao fruit.

The shop is on the 1st floor of Atre Akihabara 1, directly connected to Akihabara Station, making it an easy stop for souvenirs or early-summer gifts.

## Highlights

The Fruit Gelee places two types of fruit inside cacao fruit jelly. A 3-piece box is ¥2,484, and individual varieties are ¥810 each: white peach & pear, lemon & mango, and grape & kiwi.

Mousse Chocolat et Cacao Fruit Gelee is an assortment of three cacao fruit jellies with cut jelly textures and two chocolate mousse varieties. It is listed at ¥3,240 for 7 pieces, ¥4,320 for 10 pieces, and ¥5,400 for 13 pieces. GODIVA’s official online shop lists the product sales period from May 7 to September 1, 2026.

The summer gift assortment combines cacao fruit gelee, langue de chat cookies, and dome baumkuchen, priced at ¥3,240 for 9 pieces and ¥5,400 for 16 pieces.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: GODIVA Atre Akihabara
- **Address**: Atre Akihabara 1, 1F, 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo

summary: レトロゲーム・レトロPC専門店「BEEP秋葉原店」が、2026年5月17日をもって現店舗での営業を一時終了。中栄ビル取り壊しに伴い、SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTUREへの移転準備に入る。
content:
## 概要

レトロゲームやレトロPCを扱う「BEEP秋葉原店」が、2026年5月17日をもって現店舗での営業を一時終了します。

現店舗は東京都千代田区外神田3-9-8 中栄ビル地下1階。2015年10月のオープンから約10年半営業してきた店舗ですが、入居する中栄ビルの取り壊しに伴い、移転準備のため一時閉店となります。

## 内容

移転先は、神田消防署向かいの「SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE」3号棟。エルミタージュ秋葉原の現地取材では、2月末に閉店した日本郵政のギフトショップ「SOZO BOX」跡地にあたり、新店舗側にはすでに看板も設置されていると報じられています。

BEEP秋葉原店の公式ブログでは、5月18日以降、新店舗オープンまで営業を休止し、販売、買取、修理、問い合わせなどの業務も休止すると案内されています。店頭買取は5月11日から16日まで15:00受付終了、最終日の5月17日は終日休止です。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: BEEP秋葉原店
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田3-9-8 中栄ビル B1F
- **現店舗最終営業日**: 2026年5月17日
- **移転先**: SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE 3号棟
- **移転先住所**: 東京都千代田区神田練塀町15-1
- **内容**: 現店舗一時閉店、移転準備、さよならセール、店頭買取受付時間変更
- **料金**: 入場無料（商品購入は別途）
- **予約**: 不要

## こんな人におすすめ

- BEEP秋葉原店の現店舗を最後に訪れたい方

en.title: [Akihabara] BEEP Akihabara Temporarily Closes on May 17 Before Moving to SEEKBASE
en.summary: Retro game and retro PC specialty shop BEEP Akihabara will temporarily end operations at its current location on May 17, 2026. The shop is preparing to move to SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE due to the demolition of the Chuei Building.
en.content:
## Overview

BEEP Akihabara, a specialty shop for retro games and retro PCs, will temporarily end operations at its current location on May 17, 2026.

The current shop is located in the basement of the Chuei Building at 3-9-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. After about ten and a half years since opening in October 2015, the shop will temporarily close because the building is being demolished and the store is preparing to move.

## Highlights

The new location is in SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE Building 3, across from the Kanda Fire Station. Hermitage Akihabara reports that it will occupy the former SOZO BOX space, and signage has already been installed at the new site.

BEEP Akihabara's official blog says that from May 18 onward, all sales, buying, repairs, and inquiries will be paused until the new store opens. In-store buying closes at 15:00 from May 11 to May 16, and is suspended all day on the final day, May 17.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: BEEP Akihabara
- **Address**: Chuei Building B1F, 3-9-8 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Final Day at Current Store**: May 17, 2026
- **New Location**: SEEKBASE AKI-OKA MANUFACTURE Building 3
- **New Address**: 15-1 Kanda Neribeicho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Contents**: Temporary closure of the current store, relocation preparation, farewell sale, and changes to in-store buying hours
- **Admission**: Free (merchandise sold separately)
- **Reservation**: Not required

## Recommended For

- Those who want to visit BEEP Akihabara's current shop before it closes
- Fans tracking retro game and retro PC shop relocation news
- Visitors checking new openings and moves around SEEKBASE
- Anyone documenting changes in Akihabara's specialty shop scene

title: サイバーセキュリティカンファレンス「Hack Fes. 2026」が秋葉原UDXで開催
summary: 対面限定のサイバーセキュリティカンファレンス「Hack Fes. 2026」が、2026年7月18日に秋葉原UDXで開催。テーマは「ハッカーとサイバー防衛」で、講演、ワークショップ、スポンサーセッション、ネットワーキングパーティを予定する。
content:
## 概要

一般社団法人日本ハッカー協会によるサイバーセキュリティカンファレンス「Hack Fes. 2026」が、2026年7月18日に秋葉原UDXで開催されます。

会場は秋葉原UDX 4階のUDX Gallery+Gallery Next。オンライン配信なしの対面限定イベントとして実施され、2026年のメインテーマは「ハッカーとサイバー防衛」です。

## 内容

プログラム第一弾では、サイバー空間での攻防、宇宙サイバーセキュリティ、AIによる0-day発見、量子耐性暗号、フェイクニュース対策などを扱う講演が発表されています。

ワークショップには「徳丸本アップデート2026」や「AI時代のバグハンティング入門」などが案内されています。チケットは2026年5月13日からPeatixで販売開始。カンファレンス後にはネットワーキングパーティも予定されています。

## 開催情報

- **会場**: 秋葉原UDX 4F UDX Gallery+Gallery Next
- **住所**: 東京都千代田区外神田4-14-1
- **日程**: 2026年7月18日
- **時間**: カンファレンス10:00〜17:40予定 / ネットワーキングパーティ18:30〜20:00予定
- **内容**: 講演、ワークショップ、スポンサーセッション、ネットワーキング
- **料金**: カンファレンスのみ4,000円、カンファレンス+ネットワーキングパーティ11,000円（税込）
- **予約**: Peatixでチケット販売

## こんな人におすすめ

- サイバーセキュリティやサイバー防衛の最新トピックを追いたい方
- 技術講演やワークショップに対面で参加したいエンジニア
- バグハンティング、AIセキュリティ、量子暗号などに関心がある方
- 秋葉原UDXで開催される技術カンファレンスを探している方

en.title: [Akihabara] Cybersecurity Conference "Hack Fes. 2026" at Akihabara UDX
en.summary: "Hack Fes. 2026", an in-person-only cybersecurity conference, will be held at Akihabara UDX on July 18, 2026. The theme is "Hackers and Cyber Defense", with talks, workshops, sponsor sessions, and a networking party planned.
en.content:
## Overview

The Japan Hacker Association will hold the cybersecurity conference "Hack Fes. 2026" at Akihabara UDX on July 18, 2026.

The venue is UDX Gallery+Gallery Next on the 4th floor of Akihabara UDX. The event will be held as an in-person-only conference with no online stream, and the main theme for 2026 is "Hackers and Cyber Defense".

## Highlights

The first program announcement includes talks on cyber offense and defense, space cybersecurity, AI-powered 0-day discovery, quantum-resistant cryptography, and countermeasures against fake news.

Workshops include "Tokumaru Book Update 2026" and "Introduction to Bug Hunting in the AI Era". Tickets went on sale via Peatix on May 13, 2026. A networking party is also planned after the conference.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX 4F UDX Gallery+Gallery Next
- **Address**: 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: July 18, 2026
- **Hours**: Conference 10:00–17:40 planned / Networking party 18:30–20:00 planned
- **Contents**: Talks, workshops, sponsor sessions, networking
- **Admission**: Conference only ¥4,000; conference + networking party ¥11,000 (tax included)
- **Reservation**: Tickets sold via Peatix

## Recommended For

- Those following current topics in cybersecurity and cyber defense
- Engineers who want to attend technical talks and workshops in person
- Those interested in bug hunting, AI security, quantum cryptography, and related fields
- Visitors looking for technology conferences held at Akihabara UDX

en.title: [Akihabara] Storyteller Ayumu Shirotani Solo Show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5" at Akihabara UDX Theater
en.summary: Kaidan storyteller Ayumu Shirotani's solo show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5: The Essence of Shirotani-bushi - Kaifu Ruidan" will be held at Akihabara UDX Theater on July 24 and 25, 2026. The three-performance event features Satsuma biwa player Kyoji Maruyama as guest.
en.content:
## Overview

Kaidan storyteller Ayumu Shirotani's solo show "Zenshin Zenrei Vol.5: The Essence of Shirotani-bushi - Kaifu Ruidan" will be held at Akihabara UDX Theater on July 24 and 25, 2026.

This year's theme is "Kaifu Ruidan". The show presents the eerie, frightening, and tearful elements of kaidan through Shirotani's narration and theater production.

## Highlights

The event consists of three performances: July 24 at 19:00, July 25 at 13:00, and July 25 at 18:00. Each performance is planned to feature different kaidan stories.

The second part will include a classical kaidan piece performed with Satsuma biwa player Kyoji Maruyama. Event merchandise such as new T-shirts, tenugui towels, photo books, sticker sets, and acrylic stands will also be sold at the venue. Tickets went on sale via TicketPay at 10:00 on May 7, 2026.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Akihabara UDX Theater
- **Address**: Akihabara UDX 4F, 4-14-1 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: July 24–25, 2026
- **Times**: July 24 at 19:00 / July 25 at 13:00 and 18:00
- **Performer**: Ayumu Shirotani
- **Guest**: Kyoji Maruyama (Satsuma biwa player)
- **Contents**: Kaidan solo show, classical kaidan piece, event merchandise sales
- **Admission**: ¥5,000
- **Reservation**: Tickets sold via TicketPay

## Recommended For

- Those who want to experience Ayumu Shirotani's kaidan performance in a theater
- Visitors looking for theater and live events at Akihabara UDX Theater
- Those interested in kaidan entertainment using sound, lighting, and visuals
- Fans who want to secure tickets early for a summer kaidan event

summary: 国内最大級のポータブルオーディオフェスティバル「ポタフェス 2026夏 秋葉原」が、2026年7月11日・12日にベルサール秋葉原と秋葉原コンベンションホールの2会場で開催。157ブランドが出展し、最新イヤホン・ヘッドホン・ポータブルオーディオプレーヤーを試聴できる入場無料イベント。
content:
## 概要

「ポタフェス 2026夏 秋葉原」が、2026年7月11日・12日の2日間、ベルサール秋葉原と秋葉原コンベンションホールの2会場で開催されます。国内最大級のポータブルオーディオフェスティバルとして知られる本イベントは、今回初めて2会場に拡大。入場無料・事前登録不要で、世界中の157ブランドが最新イヤホン・ヘッドホンを試聴できる場を提供します。

## 内容

ベルサール秋葉原（B1F・1F・2F）では各ブランドの展示試聴ブースが並び、最新ワイヤレスモデルから高解像度オーディオプレーヤー、コストパフォーマンスに優れたエントリーモデルまで幅広く体験できます。ブース担当者が常駐し、製品選びの相談にも応じてくれます。

秋葉原コンベンションホール（2F）は新たに追加された会場で、ゲストトークイベントや各種プログラムが実施される予定です。詳細な出展ブランドや企画内容は今後追加発表される見込みです。

- **出展ブランド数**: 157ブランド（国内外）
- **試聴コーナー**: イヤホン、ヘッドホン、ポータブルオーディオプレーヤー
- **新会場**: 秋葉原コンベンションホールでトークイベント・プログラム開催
- **例年来場者数**: 年間100万人超

## 開催情報

- **日時**: 2026年7月11日（土）・12日（日） 11:00〜18:00（最終入場17:30）
- **会場**: ベルサール秋葉原（B1F・1F・2F）、秋葉原コンベンションホール（2F）
- **住所①**: 東京都千代田区外神田3-12-8（ベルサール秋葉原）
- **住所②**: 東京都千代田区外神田1-18-13（秋葉原コンベンションホール）
- **料金**: 入場無料
- **予約**: 不要（先着順）

## こんな人におすすめ

- 最新のイヤホン・ヘッドホンを実際に試聴して選びたい方
- ポータブルオーディオブランドの担当者から直接話を聞きたい方
- 音響機器への興味が初めてで、入門を検討している方

en.title: [Akihabara] Potafes 2026 Summer at Bellesalle Akihabara and Akihabara Convention Hall
en.summary: Japan's largest portable audio festival, Potafes 2026 Summer Akihabara, will be held on July 11-12, 2026, across two venues: Bellesalle Akihabara and Akihabara Convention Hall. Free admission with 157 brands showcasing the latest earphones, headphones, and portable audio players.
en.content:
## Overview

Potafes 2026 Summer Akihabara takes place on July 11-12, 2026, across two venues for the first time: Bellesalle Akihabara and the newly added Akihabara Convention Hall. Japan's largest portable audio festival returns with free admission and no advance registration required, bringing together 157 brands from around the world for hands-on listening sessions.

## Highlights

Bellesalle Akihabara (B1F, 1F, 2F) hosts brand booths covering everything from the latest wireless earphones to hi-res audio players and entry-level models. Brand representatives are on hand to advise on product selection.

The Akihabara Convention Hall (2F) is a new addition to the event lineup, set to host guest talk events and various programs. Full exhibitor and program details will be announced closer to the event.

- **Participating brands**: 157 (domestic and international)
- **Trial listening**: Earphones, headphones, portable audio players
- **New venue**: Convention Hall hosting talk events and programs
- **Annual attendance**: Over 1 million visitors per year

## Event Details

- **Dates**: Saturday July 11 – Sunday July 12, 2026, 11:00–18:00 (last entry 17:30)
- **Venue**: Bellesalle Akihabara (B1F/1F/2F), Akihabara Convention Hall (2F)
- **Address 1**: 3-12-8 Soto-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo (Bellesalle Akihabara)
- **Address 2**: 1-18-13 Soto-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo (Akihabara Convention Hall)
- **Price**: Free admission
- **Reservation**: Not required (first-come basis)

## Recommended For

- Anyone wanting to try the latest earphones and headphones before buying
- Visitors interested in talking directly with portable audio brand representatives
- Beginners curious about audio equipment looking for an easy entry point

content:

en.title: [Akihabara] Anime-michi Live Talk Vol.1 at ANTHEM AKIBA
en.summary: A special talk event featuring anime director Fukuda Mitsuo and producer Furuhato Naotake at ANTHEM AKIBA on June 14, 2026. The 30-year creative duo discusses behind-the-scenes stories from Gundam SEED, Brave Exkaiser, and more. Tickets ¥4,000 including one drink.
en.content:
## Overview

Anime director Fukuda Mitsuo and producer Furuhato Naotake bring their 30-year creative partnership to a live talk event, Anime-michi Live Talk Vol.1, at ANTHEM AKIBA on June 14, 2026. The duo behind Brave Exkaiser, the Cyber Formula series, and Mobile Suit Gundam SEED will share production stories, behind-the-scenes anecdotes, and episodes they can only tell now.

## Highlights

This is not a standard interview format — the event takes a live conversational approach, letting the audience share in the moment as the veterans look back on their careers. Animator Shigeta Satoru joins as a third panelist, adding additional perspective on the work from the animation floor.

- **Speakers**: Fukuda Mitsuo (anime director), Furuhato Naotake (anime producer), Shigeta Satoru (animator)
- **MC**: Kuramitsu Kazuki
- **Works covered**: Brave Exkaiser, Cyber Formula series, Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series
- **Runtime**: Approx. 120 minutes
- **Includes one drink**

> "Production stories, the atmosphere of the era, and episodes we can finally reveal" — from the official announcement

## Event Details

- **Venue**: ANTHEM AKIBA (BOX'R AKIBA Building, 2F)
- **Address**: 3-2-12 Soto-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Date**: Sunday June 14, 2026 | Doors 12:30 PM / Start 1:00 PM

en.title: [Akihabara] TOPPA!!! BASE AKIBA Hosts Shin-Ei Animation 50th Anniversary Collaboration

BASE AKIBA, operated by TOPPAN inside Akihabara Station, will host a collaboration with Shin-Ei Animation marking the studio's 50th anniversary from June 30 to July 16, 2026, featuring figure displays and a digital photo booth themed around the theatrical film Ginga Tetsudo Milky Subway.
en.content:
## Overview

TOPPA!!! BASE AKIBA, a shop operated by TOPPAN inside JR Akihabara Station, will host a collaboration with Shin-Ei Animation, the anime studio celebrating its 50th anniversary. Taking advantage of its location inside the ticket gates, the event offers limited merchandise for three of the studio's 2026 titles along with figure displays.

## Highlights

As part of the 50th anniversary celebration, original merchandise for three Shin-Ei Animation titles releasing or airing in 2026 will be sold exclusively at the shop. The centerpiece is the theatrical film Ginga Tetsudo Milky Subway: Every Station Stop, Bound for the Theater, with a digital photo booth letting visitors pose alongside the characters on screen.

- Store-exclusive original merchandise celebrating Shin-Ei Animation's 50th anniversary (3 titles releasing/airing in 2026)
- Digital photo booth themed around the theatrical film Ginga Tetsudo Milky Subway
- Special display of "Chihal & Makina" figures, including a Good Smile Company Nendoroid and a non-scale figure produced by Medicos Entertainment
- First-ever display of an in-development scale figure prototype, starting June 30
- In-store appearance of "Toffee," the character from "MUZIK TIGER" (date to be announced on official X)

> Some merchandise will also be available at satellite shops and the TOPPA!!! BASE AKIBA official online shop.

## Event Details

- **Venue**: TOPPA!!! BASE AKIBA (inside Ecute Akihabara)
- **Address**: Inside JR Akihabara Station 1F ticket gates, 1-17-6 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Dates**: June 30 (Tue) – July 16 (Thu), 2026
- **Hours**: Weekdays 10:00-21:00 / Weekends and holidays 10:00-20:00
- **Price**: Free admission (merchandise sold separately; cashless payment only)
- **Reservation**: Not required

## Recommended For

- Fans who want to check out Shin-Ei Animation's 50th anniversary lineup in one place
- Visitors who want to see figures and displays from Ginga Tetsudo Milky Subway
- Anyone looking for a collaboration shop accessible inside Akihabara Station

en.title: [Akihabara] Surugaya Gahei's mAAch ecute Branch to Close in Mid-July
en.summary: Surugaya Gahei mAAch ecute, a Shizuoka seafood restaurant, is expected to close in mid-July 2026. The sister branch, Surugaya Gahei Akihabara Chabara, will continue operating in the same Akihabara area.
en.content:
## Overview

Surugaya Gahei mAAch ecute, a seafood restaurant inside mAAch ecute Kanda-Manseibashi, is expected to close after business in mid-July 2026, according to on-the-ground reporting by AKIBA PC Hotline!. The shop, known for its own house-made shiokara and other Shizuoka seafood, is located under the former Manseibashi Station's red-brick viaduct.

## Highlights

After the closure, the sister branch, Surugaya Gahei Akihabara Chabara, located in the same Akihabara area, will continue operating. Restaurant turnover continues at mAAch ecute Kanda-Manseibashi, and nearby, a new thick-cut beef tongue restaurant, Gyutan no Lemon, is also preparing to open.

- Surugaya Gahei mAAch ecute is expected to close in mid-July 2026
- The shop served 35 varieties of house-made shiokara along with Shizuoka seafood, sake, shochu, and wine
- The sister branch, Surugaya Gahei Akihabara Chabara, will continue operating

## Event Details

- **Venue**: Surugaya Gahei mAAch ecute
- **Address**: mAAch ecute Kanda-Manseibashi, 1-25-4 Kanda Sudacho, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
- **Expected closure**: Mid-July 2026
- **Continuing branch**: Surugaya Gahei Akihabara Chabara

title: 秋葉原近くのTOPPAN旧本社ビル群、10棟の解体工事が始動
summary: TOPPANホールディングスが、秋葉原駅から徒歩8分ほどの台東区台東一丁目で「TOPPAN台東地区建替解体工事」を開始。1968年竣工の旧本社「トッパンビルディング」を含む計10棟・延べ32,013㎡を解体し、2029年9月の完了を目指す。「秋葉原の再構築」の一環とされる。
content:
## 概要

TOPPANホールディングスの創業地である台東区台東一丁目で、大規模な建替解体工事が始まった。秋葉原駅から北東へ徒歩8分ほどの一帯にある旧本社系ビル群が対象で、同社が2023年に策定した新中期経営計画に掲げる「秋葉原の再構築」の一環とみられている。

## 内容

解体対象は営業ビル1号館から3号館、西館、東館、スタジオ棟、旧年金会館、旧組合棟、ゴミ小屋2棟の計10棟、総延べ床面積は32,013.78㎡。中心となるのは1968年に下谷工場跡地へ竣工した旧本社ビル「トッパンビルディング」で、昭和の高度経済成長期から続くTOPPANグループの中核拠点だった。

- 施工は鹿島建設、2026年5月1日に解体着工
- 解体完了予定は2029年9月30日
- 都内に分散する拠点の集約・統廃合を見据えた再編計画の一環
- 跡地活用や新施設の規模・用途は2026年6月時点で未公表

> 「秋葉原の再構築」（TOPPANホールディングスの新中期経営計画より）

## 開催情報

- **場所**: TOPPANホールディングス 台東地区一帯（旧トッパンビルディング含む計10棟）
- **住所**: 東京都台東区台東一丁目
- **解体着工**: 2026年5月1日
- **完了予定**: 2029年9月30日
- **施工**: 鹿島建設
- **規模**: 計10棟・総延べ床面積32,013.78㎡

## こんな人におすすめ

- 秋葉原・台東エリアの再開発動向を追っている方
- TOPPANグループの拠点再編に関心がある方
- 秋葉原駅周辺の街並みの変化を確認したい方

en.title: [Akihabara] Demolition Begins on 10 Former TOPPAN Headquarters Buildings Near Akihabara
en.summary: TOPPAN Holdings has begun a large-scale demolition project in Taito 1-chome, about an 8-minute walk from Akihabara Station. The project will demolish 10 buildings totaling 32,013 sqm, including the former headquarters "Toppan Building" completed in 1968, with completion targeted for September 2029 as part of the company's "Akihabara Reconstruction" plan.
en.content:
## Overview

A large-scale building replacement and demolition project has begun in Taito 1-chome, Taito-ku, the founding location of TOPPAN Holdings. The targeted buildings, located about an 8-minute walk northeast of Akihabara Station, are believed to be part of the "Akihabara Reconstruction" initiative outlined in the company's mid-term management plan adopted in 2023.

## Highlights

The demolition covers 10 buildings: Sales Buildings No. 1 through 3, the West Building, the East Building, the Studio Building, the former Pension Hall, the former Union Building, and two garbage sheds, totaling 32,013.78 sqm of floor space. The centerpiece is the former headquarters "Toppan Building," completed in 1968 on the site of the old Shimoya factory, which served as a core TOPPAN Group facility since Japan's postwar high-growth era.

- Construction is handled by Kajima Corporation; demolition began May 1, 2026
- Completion is targeted for September 30, 2029
- Part of a reorganization plan to consolidate the company's scattered Tokyo facilities
- Plans for the site's future use and any new facility have not been announced as of June 2026

> "Akihabara Reconstruction" (from TOPPAN Holdings' mid-term management plan)

## Event Details

- **Location**: TOPPAN Holdings' Taito district site (10 buildings including the former Toppan Building)
- **Address**: Taito 1-chome, Taito-ku, Tokyo
- **Demolition start**: May 1, 2026
- **Target completion**: September 30, 2029
- **Contractor**: Kajima Corporation
- **Scale**: 10 buildings, 32,013.78 sqm total floor area

## Recommended For

- Readers following redevelopment trends in the Akihabara and Taito area
- Anyone interested in TOPPAN Group's facility reorganization
- Visitors tracking changes to the streetscape around Akihabara Station
